acceptance_criteria.observable: A clean checkout can install UI dependencies from the committed public npm lockfile, run typecheck and production build, keep generated dependency/build outputs out of git status, and produce Signoff patch receipts without `.signoff/` control artifacts.

oracle.description: Install/build/test commands plus a conformance test prove public npm reproducibility, generated-output cleanliness, and receipt filtering.

constraints: Preserve unrelated user work and existing behavior outside the goal
non_goals: Do not redesign UI behavior, alter Signoff protocol semantics, add a package manager, or add Python runtime dependencies.

requirements.statement: Make contributor UI first-run install reproducible from the public npm lockfile and ensure Signoff patch receipts exclude control artifacts

stop_conditions: Stop or pivot when the goal cannot be proven within the iteration budget
